_doc: Drop rules. Everything here is read by js/rules/loot.js (pure, seeded). All chances are WHOLE PERCENT unless the key says `weight`. ITEM LEVEL: ilvl = area level of the dropper + rank bonus (`ilvlBonus`), capped at `ilvlCap`. Chests use the area level + their tier bonus. An item's base is chosen from bases with dropLevel <= ilvl (see basePick). Item level is NOT the character level: a level-20 player farming a level-8 zone gets ilvl-8 items, and ilvl drives the affix tiers (affixes.json) and the salvage grade (currency.json). DROP FLOW per kill, per player (personal loot, ruling 5): 1) roll `itemDrops` for how many equipment items (normal monsters mostly drop nothing), 2) for each item roll a rarity from the `rarityByLevel` weights interpolated at the area level, multiplied by the monster kind's `rarityMult` and the player's magic find, 3) roll gold (`gold`), potions and currency (currency.json) separately — they never compete with items. STINGY ON PURPOSE: a normal monster drops an item 16-24% of the time in Act 1; most of them are white. Rares are ~0.5% of items at level 1 and ~3.4% at level 20; champions, rare monsters, bosses and locked chests multiply that. The `expected` table below is COMPUTED from these weights (scratch sim over 150 kills, 6 champions, 2 rare monsters, 0.5 bosses, 3 chests per solo hour): rares per hour 0.9 at level 1, 1.8 at 10, 3.4 at 20; uniques one per ~7 h at level 1, ~2.4 h at 10, ~1.2 h at 20; legendaries one per ~24 h at level 1, ~6 h at 10, ~2.7 h at 20, about one an hour in Legend. Over an 8-12 hour Act 1 at ~30 min a level that is roughly 18-22 rares, 4 uniques and 2 legendaries: enough that every clear has a story, few enough that each one matters. tools/sim must keep its report inside +-30% of `expected`. MAGIC FIND: `magicFind` percent from gear is turned into a multiplier on the rare/unique/legendary WEIGHTS: mult = 1 + (mf / 100) / (1 + mf / 250). 50% mf -> x1.42, 100% -> x1.71, 200% -> x2.11. Never changes how many items drop. EXTRA PLAYERS: each player rolls their own loot, so a full party already sees four times the items. On top of that each extra player in the area adds `perExtraPlayer.itemChancePct` to everyone's item drop chance and `goldPct` to gold, because monsters are tougher (ruling 5). GEAR SCORE (ruling 38): the weighted average of (ilvl + rarityBonus) over the equipped slots, empty slots counting as 0. A two-hander fills both weapon weights. Shown as a whole number; the sim reports it against the zone level, and a zone's `recommendedGearScore` is its level - 2. GOLD: amount = (base + perLevel * L) * [0.6, 1.4] * (1 + goldFind/100), dropped with `chancePct`. Item sell value = kindValue * (1 + ilvl * 0.35) * rarityMult; vendors buy at sellPct and sell at 100%.

itemDrops._doc: How many equipment items a kill gives one player. `chancePct` interpolates by area level (keyframes), `count` is weights for 1/2/3 items once something drops. Chests are in `chests`.

rarityByLevel._doc: weights per equipment item at an area level; linear interpolation between keyframes [level, normal, magic, rare, unique, legendary]

rarityMult._doc: multiplies the rare/unique/legendary weights (and `minRarity` lifts normals to magic) for the monster kind that dropped it

basePick._doc: Which base: first a slot group by weight, then a base among that group whose dropLevel <= ilvl and whose proficiency the player can use (personal loot; 20% of the time ignore proficiency so trade bait exists), weighted 1 when dropLevel is within `freshLevels` of ilvl, else `oldWeight`. Two-handers and off-hands count in `weapon`/`offhand`.

uniques._doc: When the roll says unique: pick among uniques.json entries whose base dropLevel <= ilvl and levelReq <= ilvl + 2, weighted by their `weight`; none eligible -> downgrade to rare. Legendary: same with legendaries.json powers filtered by slot/kind and ilvlMin, on a base rolled like a rare.

unidentified._doc: rare, unique and legendary drop unidentified (ruling 40): name shows as "Unidentified <base>"; right-click identifies free; trading an unidentified item is allowed (a gamble for the buyer).

perExtraPlayer._doc: per extra player present in the same area; with 4 players a normal monster drops something 18+9 = 27% of the time for EACH player

gold._doc: A level-10 kill pays 14 gold on average when it pays; a plain ilvl-10 sword sells for 12*(1+3.5)*0.2 = 10.8 gold; a rare one for 65. Vendor gear costs the full value and is normal/magic only (the gambler sells unidentified items for 3x at a flat rarity table: magic 78, rare 20, unique 1.6, legendary 0.4).

potions._doc: potion drops are separate from items: chance per kill (whole percent) and which size by area level

chests._doc: tier by what the zone places; `items` = weights for 0/1/2/3 items; ilvl = area level + bonus

gearScore.formula: round( sum(slotWeight * (ilvl + rarityBonus)) / sum(slotWeight) ) over equipped slots; empty slot contributes 0 but keeps its weight
gearScore.twoHander: contributes weapon + offhand weights with its own ilvl

expected._doc: targets for tools/sim (per solo player-hour at ~150 kills, ~6 champions, ~2 rare monsters, ~3 chests an hour)
